cause_quote: The new Doctor preflight called `assertPrivate(reference.target)` for private plugin lookups and rejected targets when `!isPathInside(privateRoot, resolvePathViaExistingAncestorSync(file))`, even when the resolved dependency was inside the staged package.
user_saw: On affected Windows npm-global installs, managed updates repeatedly rolled back after Doctor reported that a staged typebox dependency was outside the temporary update copy.
summary: Candidate Doctor now accepts dependency targets from private plugin lookups when they resolve inside either the private rehearsal copy or the staged OpenClaw package.
reasoning: The parent commit already created Windows junctions to the staged host, and its snapshot test verified that a copied plugin could load through such a link. PR #146616 added the Doctor preflight assertion that rejected dependencies reached outside the private root. The fix PR reproduced the rejection with junction-compatible symlinks, but the exact Windows importer and a full pre-change Windows update remain unverified.
